heading.title: Examination of parties by the court

article.title: Direction of the court to opt for any one mode of alternative dispute resolution.
article.content: After recording the admissions and denials, the court shall direct the parties to the suit to opt either mode of the settlement outside the court as specified in sub-section (1) of section 89. On the option of the parties, the court shall fix the date of appearance before such forum or authority as may be opted by the parties.
article.html:
1ADirection of the court to opt for any one mode of alternative dispute resolution.

Order 10, Rule 1A

After recording the admissions and denials, the court shall direct the parties to the suit to opt either mode of the settlement outside the court as specified in sub-section (1) of section 89. On the option of the parties, the court shall fix the date of appearance before such forum or authority as may be opted by the parties.

3 Ins. by Act 46 of 1999, s. 20 (w.e.f. 1-7-2002).
